chunks.text: Welcome to the Slow English podcast.
In this podcast, we speak very slowly.
Aswan is full of history and nature.
Egypt is a country in North Africa.
It is one of the oldest countries in the world.
Many people know the pyramids, but today we talk about Aswan.
Aswan is in the south of Egypt.
It is near the border with Sudan.
The city is next to the Nile River.
Life in Aswan depends on the river.
In summer, days are long and hot.
Life moves slowly because of the heat.
Aswan has a very long history.
People lived here thousands of years ago.
The city was important in ancient Egypt.
Stones for temples came from Aswan.
The Nile River is the heart of Aswan.
People see the river every day.
The water looks calm and blue.
Aswan is home to Nubian people.
Near Aswan, there are many temples.
One famous place is Philae Temple.
Another famous place is Abu Simbel.
Daily life in Aswan is slow.
Food in Aswan is simple and healthy.
People eat rice, bread and vegetables.
Fish from the Nile is popular.
Food is part of community life.
Palm trees grow near the river.
Aswan is a city of the Nile.
Ancient history, warm people and slow life.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
See you in the next episode.
